lower.claim: Sets bit five in every byte and preserves all other bits.
lower.limits: Models the fixed-width word operations directly. For the word predicate, zero and both signed minimum values are proved and the full bit-count characterization is tested.
lower.configurations: Exhaustive 256 byte inputs against the pinned same-package Go helper and independent arithmetic specification.

isPowerOfTwo.claim: Accepts words containing at most one set bit, including zero and signed minimum, at native int width.
isPowerOfTwo.limits: Models the fixed-width word operations directly. For the word predicate, zero and both signed minimum values are proved and the full bit-count characterization is tested.
isPowerOfTwo.configurations: 130 32-bit and 258 64-bit boundary rows and 60,000 samples per width at seeds 17, 2718 and 65537. Pinned same-package Go overlay runs native-width rows. Lean is exercised at both widths.

FormatUint.claim: Returns the lowercase unsigned digits for bases 2 through 36 and panics with the pinned diagnostic for other bases.
FormatUint.limits: The digit loop models the optimized native decimal and power-of-two paths through their returned bytes. 4,382 boundary rows and 60,000 seeded samples per declaration with seeds 17, 2718 and 65537.
FormatUint.configurations: Pinned native internal/strconv calls compared with the Lean executable and an independent math/big radix and staged append oracle.

FormatInt.claim: Returns the lowercase signed digits for bases 2 through 36, including the minimum signed word, and panics with the pinned diagnostic for other bases.
FormatInt.limits: The digit loop models the optimized native decimal and power-of-two paths through their returned bytes. 4,382 boundary rows and 60,000 seeded samples per declaration with seeds 17, 2718 and 65537.
FormatInt.configurations: Pinned native internal/strconv calls compared with the Lean executable and an independent math/big radix and staged append oracle.

Itoa.claim: Returns the signed native-width decimal rendering.
Itoa.limits: The model interprets 32-bit and 64-bit native integers. Direct comparison covers the host native width and omits allocation identity. 4,382 boundary rows and 60,000 seeded samples per declaration with seeds 17, 2718 and 65537.
Itoa.configurations: Pinned native internal/strconv calls compared with the Lean executable and an independent math/big radix and staged append oracle.

AppendUint.claim: Appends unsigned lowercase digits to the original destination. Invalid bases panic before destination mutation.
AppendUint.limits: Valid destination geometry is modeled with all bytes through capacity. Return nilness, backing reuse and writes visible through the original backing are compared. Allocator-selected growth capacity is outside the claim. 4,382 boundary rows and 60,000 seeded samples per declaration with seeds 17, 2718 and 65537.
AppendUint.configurations: Pinned native internal/strconv calls compared with the Lean executable and an independent math/big radix and staged append oracle.

AppendInt.claim: Appends signed lowercase digits to the original destination. A negative value appends the sign before radix validation, including the visible spare backing write on an invalid radix when capacity permits.
AppendInt.limits: Valid destination geometry is modeled with all bytes through capacity. Return nilness, backing reuse and writes visible through the original backing are compared. Allocator-selected growth capacity is outside the claim. 4,382 boundary rows and 60,000 seeded samples per declaration with seeds 17, 2718 and 65537.
AppendInt.configurations: Pinned native internal/strconv calls compared with the Lean executable and an independent math/big radix and staged append oracle.

ParseBool.claim: Returns the matching truth value for the twelve permitted raw spellings or false with the bare ErrSyntax for every other byte string.
ParseBool.limits: Arbitrary raw byte strings. Native verifies exact ErrSyntax interface identity, with error presence represented by a Boolean in Lean.
ParseBool.configurations: Pinned direct internal/strconv calls via external test overlay, compiled Lean and independent literal-table and byte-slice oracle. 4,416 fixed rows and 60,000 samples at seeds 17, 2718 and 65537.

FormatBool.claim: Returns the lowercase ASCII spelling of its Boolean argument.
FormatBool.configurations: Pinned direct internal/strconv calls via external test overlay, compiled Lean and independent literal-table and byte-slice oracle. 4,416 fixed rows and 60,000 samples at seeds 17, 2718 and 65537.

AppendBool.claim: Appends the lowercase ASCII spelling to the caller prefix. Reuses sufficient backing and preserves untouched spare cells, or allocates without changing old backing.
AppendBool.limits: Valid destination slice geometry, including nil/empty inputs and arbitrary byte prefix and spare backing. Returned allocation size after growth is outside scope; exit bytes, original backing and reuse identity are observed.
AppendBool.configurations: Pinned direct internal/strconv calls via external test overlay, compiled Lean and independent literal-table and byte-slice oracle. 4,416 fixed rows and 60,000 samples at seeds 17, 2718 and 65537.

Error.Error.claim: Returns the fixed diagnostic for each of the four known internal error tags and unknown error for any other signed tag.
Error.Error.limits: All signed native int tags. Tests include native endpoints and seeded values.
Error.Error.configurations: Pinned direct internal/strconv calls via external test overlay, compiled Lean and independent literal-table and byte-slice oracle. 4,416 fixed rows and 60,000 samples at seeds 17, 2718 and 65537.
